sloka: न शक्यसे वारयौइतुम् गच्छेदानीम् रघुत्तम ।श्रीघ्रम् च विनिवर्तस्व वर्तस्व च सताम् क्रमे ॥२-२५-२॥
transliteration: na śakyase vārayauitum gacchedānīm raghuttama ।śrīghram ca vinivartasva vartasva ca satām krame ॥2-25-2॥

translations.english: I am unable to dissuade you, O the best among the descendants of Raghus, from going into the forest. Go now and return soon. Follow in the footsteps of the virtuous.
translations.hindi: हे राम! तुम यह केसी हल्की बात कहते हो। इसे सुन कर _ तो हे राजकुमार ! मुझे हँसी आती है
